title: kb/_self/reports/research-repro.md says from repro compare's numbers how reproducible the instances' research is and where it diverges
goal: benchmarks.py repro compare --record runs over the three instances and its repro-compare rows are in kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv; kb/_self/reports/research-repro.md gives per instance and area the articles and facts added, the tag mix, the sources added and their Jaccard overlaps, the facts' overlap, the conflicts between instances, the lint and check errors, the frozen set's eval pass rate and coverage verdicts and the agreement figure, beside the run's cost, turns and wall time; it concludes how reproducible the research is and where the instances diverge; kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md has the repro and repro-compare scenarios' section and table markers, and benchmarks.py report --check passes.

run:
import csv,re,sys
rows=[r for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv',encoding='utf-8')) if r['scenario'].startswith('repro')]
import os
f='kb/_self/reports/research-repro.md'
t=open(f,encoding='utf-8').read() if os.path.exists(f) else ''
need=['Jaccard','agreement','conflict','pass rate']
miss=[w for w in need if w.lower() not in t.lower()]
metrics={r['metric'] for r in rows if r['scenario']=='repro-compare'}
print(miss,sorted(metrics)[:20]); sys.exit(0 if t and not miss and {'eval_passed','agreement','fact_overlap','url_jaccard','conflicts'}<=metrics else 1)
